summary: Rescue and firefighting level at EGPU changed to category A3, with category A4 available by prior arrangement.
text:
RESCUE AND FIRE FIGHTING CATEGORY CHANGED TO RFF CAT A3 (ON 
OCCASIONS PROVIDED WITH RFF CAT 2 UNDER REMISSION). RFF CAT A4 BY 
PPR ARRANGEMENT. 
UK AIP EGPU AD 2.6 AND DIGITAL DATASET REFERS.
